en: Multi-view black-and-white postcard showing night scenes of a modern street with shops, apartment blocks, a central abstract fountain with jets of water, and a statue in a small square. The middle band bears the title 'Dresden - Straße der Befreiung' in a decorative Gothic script. Lower images display illuminated storefronts with German signage such as a jewelry and watch shop, a department store, and a youth fashion center.
